title: Dev broker abort, 2026-10-23T12:03:53Z
source: OmniNode-ai/omnibase_infra#5304 pull request body, crash report section
summary: The dev-lane broker aborted during a Kafka ListGroups request. The broker threw an exception while converting a consumer group's internal state to its Kafka state name, the exception was not caught, and std::terminate aborted shard 0 (the only shard, --smp 1), which took the whole broker down. Docker restarted the container under the unless-stopped restart policy and the broker came back.
timeline_utc: Container created (the move to v24.3.18, commit ae8294344)
Repeated WARN topic_already_exists for onex.evt.omnibase-infra.gateway-canary.v1; routine, not the request that aborted
Last log line before the abort (same warning)
"libc++abi: terminating", then "Aborting on shard 0." with a backtrace
"Segmentation fault: si_code: 128" and "Segmentation fault on shard 0.", same backtrace frames
Docker started the container again (restart policy, no automation)
abort_time_note: The earlier ledger diagnosis gave 12:03:41Z as the abort time. The broker's own log puts the abort at 12:03:53Z; 12:03:41Z is the last line before it.
broker_log: 2026-10-23T12:03:41.375786242Z WARN  2026-10-23 12:03:41,375 [shard 0:main] kafka - create_topics.cc:185 - Failed to create topic(s) {{kafka/onex.evt.omnibase-infra.gateway-canary.v1}} error_code observed: cluster::errc::topic_already_exists

request_in_flight.backtrace_note: Frames resolved against the binary's dynamic symbol table, nearest preceding symbol; the binary has no debug info, so frames 0, 1 and the seastar reactor frames resolve only to unrelated nearest symbols and are omitted. Frames between the abort handler and group_state_to_kafka_name are libc++abi (std::terminate after an uncaught exception).
repository_clients_sending_list_groups: services/service_runtime_health_monitor.py: lists groups through the confluent AdminClient
topics/managed_staging_topic_checker.py and migration/adapter_kafka_admin_lag.py: list groups through aiokafka's admin client
request_in_flight.sending_client: unverified: the broker log at warn level does not record which client sent the request at 12:03:53Z

upstream_search: A web search found no Redpanda issue or release note for an abort in group_state_to_kafka_name. No fixed version is known.

version_bump_or_config_change.reason: No version is known to fix it, and no broker setting is known to avoid it.
follow_ups_pending_not_filed: measure whether the ListGroups v4 states filter from backend_probe.py reproduces it on a copy of the dev broker

prior_restarts_note: The 2026-10-22 night restarts were on the previous v24.2.7 container, which crash-looped on a startup assert (shard_balancer.cc:102); that is a different fault, recorded on commit ae8294344.
method: docker logs omnibase-infra-redpanda --timestamps around 12:02:30Z to 12:04:40Z. The binary /opt/redpanda/libexec/redpanda was copied out of the container and frames were resolved with nm -D against it (PIE, addresses are offsets).
